signature.name: Tell-a-friend detail
signature.description: Ten minutes after closing the tab, is there one specific thing from the page she'd remember and mention to someone?

group-a.signature_why: The loaf standing in for the zero in No. 404 is cute and I'd half-mention it, but it's a visual gag rather than a line I'd repeat.
group-a.loved: The ticket framing with 'You've drawn a number we don't have' and bold hours right under the headline.
group-a.docked: The ticket floats in empty kraft at desktop width, and the pitch doesn't say much beyond the idea.

group-b.signature_why: MENUE.HTML baked onto the loaf is exactly the thing I'd text a friend: 'the 404 bakes your typo into bread.'
group-b.loved: 'Every other 404 hides your typo. Ours bakes it into a loaf.' and the typo carved into the bread.
group-b.docked: The loaf is a flat brown ellipse with no crust, so the bread looks more like a plate than a loaf.

group-c.signature_why: 'The page you wanted isn't baked. The bread is.' is a line I'd repeat, and the crossed-out Monday is a nice touch.
group-c.loved: The full week table with today highlighted and Monday marked 'no bake', plus 'The bread is.' at the foot.
group-c.docked: At 375px the pencil strike sits on top of 'this page' and makes it hard to read.
